claim_text: High sweat loss during exercise does not by itself establish potassium deficiency or justify isolated potassium supplementation; hydration and electrolyte strategies depend on exercise duration, sweat losses, diet and individual health context.
health_goal_or_outcome: Prevent unsafe supplementation and ensure clinical context is considered.

population.other_context: People reporting high sweat levels during exercise.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Dietary and supplemental sources; verify exact product form and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Potassium fact sheet and exercise-related nutrition guidance provide general context for potassium intake and physiological function.
limitations: Sweat composition and individual losses vary; no dose or electrolyte replacement protocol from this claim.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
